title: Orsen and the Orchard
author: Astrid Quintana
blurb: Coral Reyes, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
